To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Sirius enables the secure and dependable deployment of network services across multi-cloud environments, 2) Sirius is a novel platform that combines network virtualization, security and dependability in a unique way, 3) Sirius is the first network virtualization platform that enables the deployment of network services in both private data centers and public clouds, and 4) Sirius is the only network virtualization platform to support the use of both virtual and physical network services.

Sirius: (1) is a novel, multi-tenant network infrastructure that supports the creation of virtual networks with security and performance guarantees, (2) provides the means to securely interconnect multiple clouds and private data-centers, and (3) is implemented on top of OpenStack and OpenFlow.

we have designed a network virtualization framework for multi-cloud environments that provides secure and dependable services to its customers, and that it is capable of offering the same level of security and dependabili-ty than a private network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation and evaluation of Sirius, an innovative network virtualization platform that enables the deployment of secure and dependable network services in multi-cloud environments.
the design and implementation a multi-tenant, multi-cloud, multi-domain network virtualization infrastructure that provides secure and dependable services to the end-users.
the design of a multi-cloud virtualization platform that can offer secure, dependable and high-performance services to its tenants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Sirius offers a secure and dependable multi-cloud network virtualization infrastructure.

Sirius provides a secure and dependable multi-cloud network virtualization platform, that can be used by cloud customers to deploy and run their applications, and by cloud providers to offer networking as a service to their customers.
Sirius is an open, modular, and flexible network virtualization platform that can be used to offer secure and dependable network services to multiple customers in a multi-cloud environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Sirius provides a secure and dependable network virtualization platform that enables a new breed of services, which are capable of leveraging from the best of the public clouds and the private data centers.
Sirius is a multi-tenant network platform that offers secure and dependable networking services in a multi-cloud environment.
Sirius is the first network virtualization platform that considers security and dependability in the multi-cloud context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Sirius can be used to deploy secure and dependable network virtualization platforms, even when considering multi-tenant scenarios.

multi-tenancy and multi-cloud environments can be used as a means to improve security, by allowing the deployment of a network infrastructure with a high degree of isolation between different customers.
the use of a multi-cloud infrastructure is not just a matter of cost, but it also enables new opportunities to provide more secure and dependable services to the users of the platform.
